Ms. Rebecca Sato
Utilities Project Manager, City of Westerville

Re: Westerville WTP Expansion, Contractor's Pay Application No. 7 (period ending 10/31/2026)

Dear Ms. Sato,

We have reviewed Bramhall Construction's Pay Application No. 7. Line 14, Clearwell structure, requests
$96,000.00 for work this period. Based on our 10/30 site observation, the clearwell walls are about half
complete, so we recommend reducing line 14 by $48,000.00 this period.

| | Amount |

With that adjustment, we recommend payment of $290,130.00 for Application No. 7. The contractor may include
the balance of line 14 in Application No. 8 as the work is completed. We can review this at Thursday's site
visit if helpful.

Sincerley,
Kevin Shah, P.E., Project Manager
